reviewNote: Drafted by Claude from the chart for faculty review. Not validated teaching content.
summary: Grand multip in active labor with high PPH risk and a new anti-K antibody (no compatible blood for 2 to 4 h), carboprost stocked in the hemorrhage cart despite her bronchospasm reaction, a prior L4 to S1 fusion that made her last epidural patchy, and a worsening airway exam.

asa.rationale: Pregnancy with obesity, asthma, red cell alloimmunization, and high hemorrhage risk.

decision.recommendation: proceed with an early epidural, while fixing the hemorrhage setup
decision.rationale: An early, well placed epidural is the plan and lowers GA risk. At the same time: second large bore IV, notify OB and blood bank (antigen negative units), pull carboprost from the cart, TXA ready.

redFlags.finding: Anti-K alloantibody with no compatible blood available
redFlags.evidence: Antibody screen positive: anti-D (passive from RhIG) and anti-K; antigen negative units 2 to 4 h away; prior transfusion 2022.
redFlags.implication: A PPH now has no immediately compatible blood.
redFlags.action: Escalate to blood bank and OB now, keep the hemorrhage plan ready, TXA available, consider cell saver for any operative delivery.

redFlags.finding: Carboprost in the hemorrhage cart despite a documented bronchospasm reaction
redFlags.evidence: Carboprost 2022: wheezing and SpO2 88%; allergy alert overridden when stocking; asthma.
redFlags.action: Remove carboprost; use oxytocin, methylergonovine (BP allows), misoprostol, TXA.

redFlags.finding: High PPH risk with one IV
redFlags.evidence: Grand multip, polyhydramnios (AFI 26), EFW 4250 g, prior atony 1600 mL; second IV not placed.
redFlags.action: Second large bore IV now, quantitative blood loss, oxytocin after delivery.

redFlags.finding: Prior L4 to S1 fusion with laminectomy and a patchy previous epidural
redFlags.evidence: 2018 op note; 2022 epidural 4 attempts, asymmetric block; clinic plan: early epidural by attending, ultrasound, L2-3 or above, consider CSE or DPE; baseline right L5 numbness. OB H&P incorrectly says no prior back surgery.
redFlags.implication: Failed or patchy block, higher dural puncture risk.
redFlags.action: Attending with ultrasound, enter above the fusion, CSE or DPE, document baseline neuro exam, test the block early.

redFlags.evidence: Mallampati III now (II at 28 weeks), BMI 38, short neck; ate dinner at 1900.
redFlags.action: Early functioning epidural to avoid GA; aspiration prophylaxis; difficult airway equipment.

redFlags.evidence: O negative; passive anti-D from RhIG.

planItems.item: Early epidural or CSE at L2-3 or above with ultrasound
Second large bore IV, TXA available, hemorrhage cart corrected
Quantitative blood loss, frequent block checks
Difficult airway plan if GA is needed

boothComplications.why: Epidural with possible unintended dural puncture near prior surgery
